extra_vocab.en: to stop making or selling something
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡是被動語態 has been discontinued，指這款果汁機已經停產，所以客服改提供較新的型號。這個字是客服、採購與公告裡很常見的說法。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: discontinue 後面直接接名詞（discontinue a product），不接 to V；表示商品停產時常用被動：be discontinued。

example.en: The company discontinues older printer models every spring to make room for new ones.
example.zh: 公司每年春天都會讓舊款印表機停產，好為新款騰出空間。

example.en: The store discontinued that phone case last month because sales were low.
example.zh: 商店上個月因為銷量低而停賣那款手機殼。

example.en: Discontinued items are sold at half price while supplies last.
example.zh: 已停產的商品在售完為止前以半價出售。

example.en: We are discontinuing the free shipping offer at the end of June.
example.zh: 我們將在六月底停止免運費優惠。

example.en: The firm decided to discontinue a product that lost money.
example.zh: 公司決定讓一項虧錢的產品停產。

example.en: The bank will discontinue the service after December thirty-first.
example.zh: 銀行將在十二月三十一日後停止這項服務。

example.en: The factory will discontinue production of the old model soon.
example.zh: 工廠很快就會停止生產舊款型號。

example.en: That color has been discontinued, so please choose another one.
example.zh: 那個顏色已經停產，所以請選擇別的顏色。

examples.en: We are sorry, but this model was discontinued last year.
examples.zh: 很抱歉，這個型號去年就停產了。

examples.en: We plan to discontinue the paper catalog starting next spring.
examples.zh: 我們計畫從明年春天起停止發行紙本型錄。

examples.en: Please order extra parts before the supplier discontinues them.
examples.zh: 請在供應商停產這些零件前多訂一些。

confusable.diff: discontinuous 是形容詞「不連續的、中斷的」，拼法很像 discontinue，但不是停產的意思。
confusable.usage: discontinue 是動詞，discontinuous 是形容詞，後面不能直接接受詞。

example.en: A discontinuous power supply stopped the machines several times today.
example.zh: 不穩定的供電讓機器今天停了好幾次。

similar.diff: stop 是最一般的「停止」；discontinue 較正式，常用於停產或停止服務。

example.en: Please stop using the old form after the end of June.
example.zh: 六月底之後，請停止使用舊表格。

similar.diff: phase out 是逐步淘汰，過程較慢；discontinue 是決定不再繼續供應。

example.en: We will phase out the old model over the next six months.
example.zh: 我們會在接下來六個月逐步淘汰舊款型號。

similar.diff: cancel 是取消已安排的事（航班、訂單）；discontinue 是結束持續提供的產品或服務。

example.en: The airline had to cancel the morning flight because of fog.
example.zh: 因為起霧，航空公司必須取消早上的班機。

example.en: You can cancel your order within twenty-four hours.
example.zh: 你可以在二十四小時內取消訂單。

example.en: The company will suspend sales until the problem is fixed.
example.zh: 公司在問題解決前會暫停銷售。

example.en: We will replace the broken part free of charge.
example.zh: 我們會免費更換損壞的零件。

example.en: The outdated software caused many errors in the system.
example.zh: 過時的軟體讓系統出現許多錯誤。

derived.link: 最基礎的字。discontinue = dis-（不、相反）+ continue，不再繼續，像 disagree、disconnect
continue + -ation，動詞變名詞，像 educate → education
discontinue + -ation，把「停產」這件事變成名詞

senses.en: to stop making or selling a product or service

example.en: The manufacturer discontinued the older blender after a design change.
example.zh: 設計改版後，製造商讓舊款果汁機停產了。

senses.en: to stop doing or using something
senses.distinguish: 受詞是 treatment、membership、use 這類字時，指中止做某件事，不是產品停產。

example.en: Please discontinue use of the device if it becomes hot.
example.zh: 如果裝置變燙，請停止使用。

extra_vocab.en: something wrapped or packed to be sent by mail
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡指要寄回公司的包裹，客服請顧客把退貨品打包成包裹。parcel 在多益常見於寄送、退貨與物流情境。

example.en: The courier picked up twelve parcels from our warehouse today.
example.zh: 快遞員今天從我們的倉庫收走十二個包裹。

example.en: You can send a parcel from any post office.
example.zh: 你可以在任何一間郵局寄包裹。

example.en: Parcel delivery usually takes two to five working days.
example.zh: 包裹遞送通常要兩到五個工作天。

example.en: Customers can track a parcel on our website.
example.zh: 顧客可以在我們的網站上追蹤包裹。

example.en: Parcel post is cheaper than express mail for heavy items.
example.zh: 寄重的物品時，包裹郵寄比快捷郵件便宜。

examples.en: Please pack the items in a strong parcel before sending them.
examples.zh: 寄出前，請把物品用堅固的包裹裝好。

examples.en: The parcel will arrive at your office within three days.
examples.zh: 包裹會在三天內送到你的辦公室。

examples.en: We have shipped your parcel and attached the tracking number.
examples.zh: 我們已寄出你的包裹，並附上追蹤編號。

similar.diff: package 泛指包裝好的東西，也可指套裝方案；parcel 專指要寄送的包裹，英式用法較常見。

example.en: The package from the supplier arrived this morning.
example.zh: 供應商寄來的包裹今天早上到了。

similar.diff: packet 是小包裝、小袋或小盒；parcel 通常是較大、要郵寄的包裹。

example.en: A small packet of samples was inside the box.
example.zh: 盒子裡有一小包樣品。

example.en: Shipping is free for orders over fifty dollars.
example.zh: 訂單超過五十美元就免運費。

example.en: Please attach the shipping label to the outside of the box.
example.zh: 請把運送標籤貼在箱子外面。

example.en: The courier will pick up the parcel at noon.
example.zh: 快遞員中午會來取包裹。

example.en: The postage for this parcel is about twelve dollars.
example.zh: 這個包裹的郵資大約十二美元。

senses.en: something packed to be sent by mail

example.en: A parcel arrived at the reception desk this morning.
example.zh: 今天早上有一個包裹送到櫃檯。

senses.en: a piece of land that is part of a larger area
senses.distinguish: 後面接 of land 或出現 developer、property 時，指一塊土地，不是包裹。

example.en: The developer bought a large parcel of land near the port.
example.zh: 開發商買下港口附近一大塊土地。

extra_vocab.en: in the best situation; if everything can be as good as possible
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡是客氣的建議，客服說 ideally use the original box，意思是「最好用原本的盒子，但不一定非得這樣」。語氣比 must 輕，比較有彈性。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: ideally 常放在句首（Ideally, we should ...）或要求的動詞前，表示最好這樣做、但不是硬性規定。

example.en: The hotel is ideally located next to the airport.
example.zh: 這間飯店位置絕佳，就在機場旁邊。

example.en: She is ideally suited for the manager position.
example.zh: 她非常適合擔任經理職務。

example.en: Our shop is ideally placed for office workers on a lunch break.
example.zh: 我們的店位置理想，很適合午休的上班族。

examples.en: Ideally, we should finish the report before the client visits.
examples.zh: 最理想的是，我們在客戶來訪前完成報告。

examples.en: Ideally, applicants should have two years of sales experience.
examples.zh: 最好是應徵者有兩年的業務經驗。

examples.en: Please reply by noon, or ideally even sooner.
examples.zh: 請在中午前回覆，最好是更早。

confusable.diff: ideal 是形容詞「理想的」，也可當名詞；ideally 是副詞，用來修飾動詞或整個句子。
confusable.usage: ideal 修飾名詞（an ideal place），ideally 修飾動詞或整句（Ideally, we should ...）。

example.en: The quiet room is ideal for private meetings.
example.zh: 這間安靜的房間很適合開私人會議。

similar.diff: preferably 強調個人偏好、比較想要；ideally 強調情況最理想時的做法。

example.en: Please send two copies of the form, preferably in color.
example.zh: 請寄兩份表格，最好是彩色的。

similar.diff: 意思接近，但 in an ideal world 暗示現實中很難做到，語氣更像在說遺憾。

example.en: In an ideal world, every order would arrive on time.
example.zh: 在理想的世界裡，每筆訂單都會準時送到。

example.en: This room is suitable for a small meeting.
example.zh: 這個房間適合開小型會議。

example.en: The new system works perfectly after the update.
example.zh: 更新之後，新系統運作得很完美。

derived.link: 最基礎的字。ideal + -ly，形容詞變副詞，像 quick → quickly

senses.en: if possible; in the best way

example.en: Ideally, the sample should reach us before Friday.
example.zh: 樣品最好在星期五前送到我們這裡。

senses.en: in a way that is perfect for something
senses.distinguish: 後面接 located、suited、placed 等字時，指位置或條件剛好很理想。

example.en: The office is ideally situated close to the subway station.
example.zh: 這間辦公室位置理想，靠近地鐵站。

extra_vocab.zh: 吵鬧的、嘈雜的、噪音大的
extra_vocab.en: making a lot of sound that is unpleasant
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡是顧客抱怨果汁機變得 extremely noisy，也就是運轉聲音很大，是商品瑕疵的一個徵兆。多益常見於客訴、辦公環境與旅館情境。

example.en: The new fan is noisier than the old one.
example.zh: 新的風扇比舊的更吵。

example.en: This is the noisiest machine on our whole production line.
example.zh: 這是我們整條生產線上最吵的機器。

example.en: A noisy machine in the workshop is disturbing everyone nearby.
example.zh: 工作間裡一台噪音很大的機器正在打擾附近的每個人。

example.en: It is hard to focus in a noisy environment.
example.zh: 在嘈雜的環境裡很難專心。

example.en: The apartment is in a noisy neighborhood near the station.
example.zh: 這間公寓位在車站附近一個吵鬧的社區。

example.en: A noisy open office can lower staff productivity and focus.
example.zh: 吵鬧的開放式辦公室可能降低員工的效率和專注力。

examples.en: The air conditioner became noisy after only one month of use.
examples.zh: 冷氣只用了一個月就變得很吵。

examples.en: The office is too noisy for phone calls, so I work at home.
examples.zh: 辦公室吵到不能講電話，所以我在家工作。

examples.en: My hotel room was noisy because it faced a busy street.
examples.zh: 我的飯店房間很吵，因為面對繁忙的街道。

confusable.diff: nosy 是「愛打聽、好管閒事的」，拼法和 noisy 只差一個字母，但意思完全不同。

example.en: My nosy coworker keeps asking about my salary.
example.zh: 我那位愛打聽的同事一直問我的薪水。

similar.diff: loud 強調音量大，不一定令人不悅；noisy 強調吵雜、令人煩。

example.en: The music was too loud for a quiet business dinner.
example.zh: 這音樂對安靜的商務晚餐來說太大聲了。

example.en: The quiet room is perfect for reading reports.
example.zh: 這間安靜的房間很適合讀報告。

example.en: Please do not disturb guests who are sleeping.
example.zh: 請不要打擾正在睡覺的客人。

example.en: We received three complaints about the noise last week.
example.zh: 我們上星期收到三件關於噪音的客訴。

example.en: Please turn down the volume during the video meeting.
example.zh: 視訊會議期間請把音量調小。

derived.link: 最基礎的字。noisy = noise 去掉 e 加 -y，變成形容詞，像 sun → sunny
noisy 的 -y 換成 -ily，形容詞變副詞，像 easy → easily
noise + -less（沒有），沒有聲音的，像 useless、homeless
